Mali.title: Terrorist-Tuareg Alliance Leaves Mali’s Junta on Shaky Ground
Mali.summary: Two years after canceling a peace agreement with Tuareg separatists, Mali’s ruling junta is no closer to restoring security to the country, according to analysts. Instead, the junta appears to have undermined its own counterterrorism efforts by prompting the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) to align with terrorists. “They [the Malian government] decided the factions in the north were terrorists equal to JNIM [Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin] and would be fought the same way,” Wassim Nasr, senior researcher at The Soufan Center, told ADF.

Burkina Faso.title: Disappearance of Moussa Kaka in Niger: "Absolutely nothing justifies his arrest"
Burkina Faso.summary: In Niger, journalist Moussa Kaka has been missing since 31 August. Senegalese Alioune Tine, who has been a UN expert on human rights, regrets what he calls "the total indifference of the African and international community" towards this "enforced disappearance". And he calls for the mobilization of African opinion and the organizations that represent it .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Exiled Burkina Publisher Tells RFI of Repression and Fear Four Years After Coup
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso on Wednesday marks four years since military strongman Captain Ibrahim Traoré took over in a coup. Comparing himself to anti-colonial icon Thomas Sankara, Traoré promised a "progressive and popular" revolution. RFI spoke to Inoussa Ouédraogo, a publishing director who now lives in exile about the country's fading human rights record.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Opponents in exile publish a documented list of 86 kidnappings perpetrated by the junta
Burkina Faso.summary: Put online on social networks under the title "The disappeared of Ibrahim Traoré" on the occasion of the fourth anniversary of the military coup of September 30, 2022, this trombinoscope intends to denounce the authoritarianism of the junta in power in Ouagadougou and honor the memory of those who were victims of its repression .

Burkina Faso.title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has inaugurated its first gold refinery as its military-led government seeks to strengthen economic sovereignty after breaking ties with its traditional Western partners. “From now on, Burkina Faso’s gold must not only be mined in Burkina Faso; it must also be processed, controlled, valued and certified there,” President Ibrahim Traoré said on Monday at the inauguration of the refinery, named Raffinor-BF.

Burkina Faso.title: 5 Burkina Faso: A Historic Night
Burkina Faso.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) is held this Wednesday, September 30, 2026 from 6 p.m. at the Place de la Révolution in Ouagadougou. This high-profile activity has a double objective: to pay tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP) and to present the achievements made in four years in various fields (health, agriculture, sport, technology, mining, etc.).

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Opens First Gold Refinery
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has opened its first gold refinery as the military-led government seeks greater control over the country's mineral wealth and to reduce its reliance on exporting raw materials. The Raffinor-BF facility in Ouagadougou cost more than $19 million and has a refining capacity of 164 tonnes of gold per year, with plans to eventually increase capacity to 515 tonnes.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso opens first gold refinery in push for economic independence
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso opened its first gold refinery on Monday, pushing ahead with plans to better organise the commercialisation of the precious metal in one of the continent's top producers. The west African nation is the continent's third leading gold producer, churning out more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal last year, according to the World Gold Council. But authorities traditionally struggle to control the informal gold mining sector, which has been blighted by jihadist violence and smuggling.

Burkina Faso.title: 7 Burkina Faso: Burkina Faso Launches First Gold Refinery
Burkina Faso.summary: According to a statement by the Burkina Faso government's Information Service, Mr Traore said Burkina Faso has "reached a historic milestone in its quest for economic independence." Burkina Faso has launched its first gold refinery, the RAFFINOR-BF refinery, with the primary aim of processing its mineral resources domestically. The country's military leader, Ibrahim Traore, inaugurated the refinery in Ouagadougou on Monday.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso launches first gold refinery
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has launched its first gold refinery, the RAFFINOR-BF refinery, with the primary aim of processing its mineral resources domestically. The country’s military leader, Ibrahim Traore, inaugurated the refinery in Ouagadougou on Monday. He described the refinery as a part of the administration’s plan to cut dependence on primary exports.

Burkina Faso.title: Traoré marks four years in power, following Sankara’s legacy
Burkina Faso.summary: Captain Ibrahim Traoré has now led Burkina Faso for four years, the same length of time Thomas Sankara was in power. Both came to power as young, red-beret-wearing army captains, promising national sovereignty, Pan-Africanism and greater economic independence. Sankara, who seized power in 1983, launched what he called a “democratic and popular revolution,” promoting education, women’s empowerment, self-reliance and local production.

Burkina Faso.title: Crash of the Ouagadougou-Alger flight: Swiftair condemned
Burkina Faso.summary: The families of the victims had to wait twelve years. Gathered within the association "AH-5017 Ensemble", they led a "relentless fight for truth and justice" which is now experiencing its judicial outcome. The Spanish company Swiftair is found guilty of manslaughter this Monday morning by the Paris Criminal Court .

Niger.title: Drug trafficking: two young people in their twenties arrested with 12,000 Tramadol tablets at the Tillabéri road barrier
Niger.summary: Published on Tuesday, December 30, 2025 | actuniger.com The vigilance of the security forces has once again borne fruit . On December 22, 2025, officers of the Yantala Police Station seized 12,000 Tramadol tablets during a routine check at the Tillabéri road barrier, thwarting an attempt to transport drugs to a gold site in the region, with the arrest of two young Nigeriens in their twenties .

Niger.title: Niger: what we know about the jihadist attack that targeted Niamey airport
Niger.summary: Niger: what we know about the jihadist attack that targeted the Niamey airport Published on Saturday, January 31, 2026 | AFP In the night from Wednesday to Thursday, the Niamey airport in Niger suffered a brief attack claimed Friday by the Islamic State, in a country where jihadist violence usually occurs in the west and south-east The Nigerien military junta, helped by "Russian partners", accused the French, Beninese and Ivorian presidents of being the "sponsors" of the attackers, words condemned by Abidjan and Cotonou on Friday.

Niger.summary: Defense: General Tiani reshuffles the military command after the Niamey mutiny Published on Saturday, September 12, 2026 | actuniger.com Two weeks to the day after the Niamey mutiny, the President of the Republic and Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, General Abdourahamane Tiani, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, reshuffled the head of the Niger army on Friday, September 11, 2026 According to a statement from the Ministry of National Defence read in the evening on public television, the post of Chief of the Armed Forces Staff (CEMA), Major General Moussa Salaou Barmou, a member of the CNSP and in office since…

Niger.title: Niger: Islamic State claims responsibility for attack on Niamey airport
Niger.summary: Published on Friday, January 30, 2026 | AFP The Islamic State claimed responsibility on Friday for the attack on Niamey airport in Niger, said the Site group, which specializes in counter-terrorism research . On the night of Wednesday to Thursday, Niamey airport, which is home to military sites and is about ten kilometers from the presidency, was the target of an attack leaving 20 dead on the attacking side, according to the Nigerien military junta .

Niger.title: Niger: A Significant Quantity of Cocaine Worth More Than 2.5 Billion FCFA Seized in Agadez
Niger.summary: Niger: A large quantity of cocaine worth more than 2.5 billion FCFA seized in Agadez This is a hard blow for drug traffickers in Niger. The country's national gendarmerie caught three individuals carrying a significant amount of cocaine. The events took place on September 14, about fifteen kilometers from the village of RTA (Agadez region) .

Niger.title: Fight against drugs: 50 kg of cocaine worth 2.5 billion CFA seized in Agadez
Niger.summary: The defence and security forces of the Agadez region in northern Niger have just carried out a nice operation to seize a large quantity of hard drugs. It is, in fact, more than 50 kg of pure cocaine, with an estimated value of more than 2.5 billion CFA, which were intercepted by elements of the National Gendarmerie, who also seized other narcotic products during a security operation conducted in the department of Arlit, in the same region, on the Algerian border.

Niger.title: After the abortive coup d 'état, Niger joined the anti-Emirate axis
Niger.summary: The failed coup attempt of 28 August at Niamey airport shifted Niger to the side of Algeria in the anti-United Arab Emirates axis. By Nathalie Prevost A telephone conversation with General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan a week ago, followed, two days later, by an audience with the Sudanese ambassador to Niger . General Abdourahamane Tiani embraces the maxim of international relations: "the enemies of my enemies are my friends".

Niger.title: Air Force: Colonel Alka Mahaman Sani now in command of Niamey Air Base 101
Niger.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Air Force, Air Brigadier General Salifou MAINASSARA, chaired, Friday, September 17, at Air Base 101 in Niamey, the handover ceremony between the Commander of the outgoing base, Air Brigadier General Sidi Oumar KA ISMAEL KA, and incoming, Colonel ALKA Mamane Sani . Commander of base 201 in Agadez since 2024, the new boss of the most important and strategic air base of the Nigerien forces is an officer specializing in aeronautics and military air transport.

Niger.title: Attempted destabilization: an ESA delegation in Niamey to mark the solidarity of the Confederation in Niger
Niger.summary: This Friday, September 18, 2026, a delegation from the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), composed of Burkinabe and Malian ministers in charge of Defence and Foreign Affairs, was received in Niamey by the President of the Republic, Army General Abdourahamane Tiani . The meeting was an opportunity for the delegation to express the solidarity of Burkina Faso and Mali in Niger, after the destabilization attempt that occurred on the night of 28 to 29 August 2026, and to offer its condolences to the families of the victims .
